name: The Bed KLCC
detail: I had a 13 hour layover in Kuala Lumpur on my way to Kathmandu, so I decided to go out the airport and see Petronas Twin Towers and have a decent place to sleep for the night as I arrived around 10 pm from Hongkong. I actually booked at The Bed in advance and I just paid around 800PHP via Agoda for one night! I took the female solo pod which consists of a shoe locker outside, a dental kit, towel, a locker beneath the bed and a bed with cover. That is already great because the accommodation is quite good, cozy, and good for solo traveller like me. LOCATION: It took me around 45 minutes to 1 hour to get to The Bed from the airport giving that the KLIA Expres travel time to KL Sentral is 28 to 30 minutes. From KL Sentral, get a (coin) ticket via RapidKL to Dang Wangi station (if you don't mind walking around 10 minutes to hotel),turn left,take the overpass,walk straight until you saw Bukit Nanas station. Cross the street. The nearest station from the hotel is Bukit Nanas station,which I took from the hotel to KL Sentral that cost me 3.70 MYR. I don't saw in the map that Bukit Nanas station will be passed by using Gombak line from KL Sentral because it is in the Titiwangsa line which you can also take,just walk from KL Sentral to Mid Valley station. The Bed is in the Vortex building, beside 7-11 so you will be able to see it clearly. RECEPTION: I checked in near midnight, and the receptionist is a Filipino and also some other Filipinos are checking in that time. The check in and check out was smooth and incredibly fast. INTERNET CONNECTION: Wi-Fi is reliable and good. I can still do some video calls while at the washroom and any part of the hotel. FOOD: The food was not that good, without variety. Breakfast was only a Malaysian rice (with peanuts,dried fish and half hard boiled egg) and breads. The drinks was water, coffee and tea. I hope they will add more in the future. name: Dorsett Grand Subang
detail: Great Hotel and certainly, I will stay again. But there are few hmmmms. One is the smoke smells at the corridor. I was staying at standard Dorsett room but this smoking smell from the corridor is unacceptable. You take a bath, dry your hair, getting ready and just after you open the door, the smell destroys motivations to go out. Also, the shower head was broken. Otherwise, the best experience, as always, is the breakfast restaurant. I quite enjoy the place. It has this classic hotel feelings which I can not find anywhere in kuala lumpur anymore (There are some in Penang still but not in KL). I would seriously recommend some form of renovation on this damages caused by smokers or perhaps take a bit of a money from smokers as these people will ruin everything but pay nothing more. Please keep up!! Thank you very much!!

name: Sunway Pyramid Hotel
detail: Known as a perfect holiday retreat, this property is simply the ultimate destination for groups of friends, family, or lovers. With the location in the heart of an amusement park, guests will be delighted to surf the world’s largest man made beach, while strolling through the longest and highest bridge in Kuala Lumpur, go riding the rollercoaster or even go shopping at the Sunway Pyramid. With Water Park, Extreme Park, Wildlife Park and Amusement Park on site, a land full of fun and excitement awaits at Sunway Pyramid Hotel @ Sunway Resort. Also, this four star property boasts 764 rooms and suites that are sophisticated and elegantly designed. Sunway Pyramid Hotel @ Sunway Resort is also brilliantly appointed and offers a swimming pool, fitness center from 6.00am to 12 midnight only, excellent variety of onsite restaurants, and they also feature an aerobics class for a good work out session. All in all, Sunway Pyramid Hotel @ Sunway Resort is a perfect hideaway from the workloads.

name: St. Giles Mid Valley Kuala Lumpur
detail: I booked the hotel as part of our London to Sydney road trip when we required a good convenient hotel in Kuala Lumpur to stay in to await the arrival of our car from India and to plan our next phase of the journey to Australia. The hotel is very large, but has all the services expected of a first class hotel. The swimming pool and gymnasium are excellent especially the gym which is very well equipped. The lobby bar is comfortable with some very friendly and helpful staff. The conciege too were helpful throughout our stay. Some people might find it too big to stay in because it doesn't have the intimacy of smaller hotels but for my purposes it was an excellent choice. Barry Hawgood
